background.comment: ADR-0051 — corrected from {color.semantic.success}, was violating Brand Guide v1.0 §11.3 ("do not use Brand Green as Success" applied in reverse: Primary must not ride on the Success token)

background-hover.comment: ADR-0051 — direct primitive step per Brand Guide v1.0 §8.2, not routed through semantic.success-hover

background.comment: ADR-0051 — corrected from {color.semantic.danger} (which aliased {color.brand.secondary}), was violating Brand Guide v1.0 §11.3 ("do not use Brand Red as Error"). This is the `Destructive` variant per Brand Guide §8.1.
ADR-0051 — new, shared by all button variants per Brand Guide v1.0 §8.2

text.comment: ADR-0051 — color alone is not the disabled signal; consuming components MUST also apply reduced opacity, cursor: not-allowed, and aria-disabled per §8.2

ring.comment: ADR-0051 — new, independent of button color per Brand Guide v1.0 §9
